---
title: "Performance"
---

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from _dashboard_utils import load_portfolio_performance, load_positions, load_validation_results

portfolio_performance = load_portfolio_performance()
positions = load_positions()
_, candidates = load_validation_results()

portfolio_live = len(portfolio_performance) > 0
positions_live = len(positions) > 0
```

## Row {height="15%"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
if not portfolio_live and not positions_live:
    print("""
::: {.card title="Not yet available"}

Portfolio Construction, Risk Management, and Paper Trading Execution are
still in development — this page will populate automatically with a live
equity curve and current positions once those pipeline stages exist.

:::
""")
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Portfolio Equity Curve"
if portfolio_live:
    fig = px.line(portfolio_performance, x="date", y="equity")
else:
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_annotation(text="No portfolio equity data yet", showarrow=False)
    fig.update_xaxes(visible=False)
    fig.update_yaxes(visible=False)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Current Positions"
if positions_live:
    fig = go.Figure(
        go.Table(
            header=dict(values=list(positions.columns), align="left"),
            cells=dict(values=[positions[column] for column in positions.columns], align="left"),
        )
    )
else:
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_annotation(text="No open positions yet", showarrow=False)
    fig.update_xaxes(visible=False)
    fig.update_yaxes(visible=False)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0))
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="40%"}

::: {.card title="Candidate-level backtest performance (research) — not a live portfolio"}

The charts below summarize historical backtest results across all 216
individually-tested candidates. They are research diagnostics, not a
portfolio equity curve — no strategies are currently deployed or combined
into a live portfolio.

:::

```{python}
#| title: "Net Sharpe Distribution"
fig = px.histogram(candidates, x="net_sharpe", color="family", nbins=40)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), legend_title_text="")
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Net Sharpe vs. Max Drawdown"
fig = px.scatter(
    candidates,
    x="net_max_drawdown",
    y="net_sharpe",
    color="family",
    hover_name="candidate_id",
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), legend_title_text="")
fig.show()
```
